comment: The one HTML path published at bdenckla.github.io/Taamey_D/, frozen from source commit 38134991aceee6493444ab6f56b04b89b6d06ebf before the 2026-09-17 redirect flip. The explicit mapping sends that legacy index to hbofonts/Taamey_D.html rather than applying a same-suffix prefix rewrite. The source host keeps its stylesheet and four WOFF2 assets byte-for-byte, so static assets are deliberately not redirect-manifest entries.
